site.name: 18 G-TAS
site.title: 18 G-TAS is back
site.tagline: Est. 2008. Eighteen years later, 18 G-TAS is back. Help choose the first drop.

home.lead: Est. 2008. Eighteen years later, KZN's own label is back with new designs for two generations, and this time the first drop is chosen by you.
home.shareText: 18 G-TAS is back after 18 years! Help choose the first drop:

peek.title: {count} new designs. Nobody has seen them yet.
peek.titleFallback: New designs. Nobody has seen them yet.
peek.body: The team is narrowing them down right now. Soon you will swipe through the shortlist on your phone: YEBO or CHA. Your swipes help decide what we make.
peek.revealTitle: {count} designs made the cut. You decide.
peek.revealBody: Picked by the 18 G-TAS team from {total} new designs. Swipe each one YEBO or CHA, choose your number one, then submit. One vote per phone.
peek.ctaVote: Make your choice: YEBO or CHA
peek.ctaSoon: Voting opens soon. Tell your crew

eiteen.name: EITEEN
eiteen.body: Kasi, pixel, street. Loud colour and big 18s, made for the block.

gtas.name: XVIII · G-TAS
gtas.body: Gold, Roman numerals and monograms. Quiet luxury that lasts.

team.title: The team picks
team.body: Behind the scenes, the 18 G-TAS team narrows every new design down to a shortlist.

public.title: You swipe
public.body: Open the link from our Facebook page or your WhatsApp group. Swipe right for YEBO, left for CHA, then submit. One vote per phone, no account needed.

final.title: Ten tees drop
final.body: Your votes help choose the ten tees that go to print for the comeback drop.

closing.title: 18 G-TAS is back. Pass it on.
closing.body: Voting opens soon. Share this with your crew so nobody misses the first drop.
closing.note: Watch our Facebook page and WhatsApp groups for the voting link.

footer.tagline: Est. 2008 · Custom Clothing & Design · KwaZulu-Natal, Mzansi
footer.copyright: © {year} 18 G-TAS Custom Clothing & Design, trading as 18 G-TAS. All rights reserved.
footer.ip: All designs, artwork, the 18 mark, EITEEN and XVIII · G-TAS belong to 18 G-TAS. Do not copy, print or sell them.
footer.affiliation: 18 G-TAS is not affiliated with any football club, federation or sportswear brand.
footer.groupNote: “Contact us” opens the 18 G-TAS WhatsApp group, where other members can see your number. Under 18? Ask a parent or guardian first. For anything private (your data, a privacy request, team sign-in), message us directly on {number}.

legal.toBeReviewed: TO BE REVIEWED. This is placeholder text and has not been checked by a legal adviser.

auth.signinBody: Sign-in is by personal invite. Ask the 18 G-TAS admin on WhatsApp for your link. It works once, on one phone, for 24 hours.
auth.joinBody: This is your personal sign-in link for the 18 G-TAS team. Tap below to sign in on this phone. Don’t forward it: it works only once.
auth.joinInvalidBody: It has expired or was already used. Ask the admin for a fresh link on WhatsApp.
auth.membersBody: This is where you will pick and rank your favourite designs when the admin opens the team round. Your picks stay private until everyone has submitted.
auth.adminLead: Send each team member a personal sign-in link on WhatsApp. Each link works once and expires in 24 hours. A new link cancels the old one.
auth.inviteReady: Link for {name}, works until {time} (SA time). Send it now:
auth.inviteText: Hi {name}, here is your personal sign-in link for the 18 G-TAS design vote. It works once, on one phone, and expires in 24 hours: {url}
auth.inviteError: Could not create the link. Try again.
auth.slow: Too many sign-in tries from this network. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.joinUsedTitle: This link has already been used
auth.joinUsedBody: It has already signed someone in, maybe you on another phone or browser. Open the team page there. If it wasn’t you, ask the admin for a new link and to sign out the other phone.
auth.joinExpiredBody: It expired on {time} (SA time). Ask the admin for a fresh link on WhatsApp.
auth.joinUnknownBody: It may have been replaced by a newer link (each new link cancels the older ones), or part of it was cut off when copied. Open the newest link you were sent, or ask the admin for a fresh one.

round.title: Your picks
round.homeDraft: The team round hasn’t opened yet. The admin will let you know on WhatsApp.
round.homeOpen: The team round is open. Pick and rank your {n} favourite designs.
round.homeWaiting: {submitted} of {invited} have submitted. Results open when everyone is in.
round.homeNotInRound: You are not picking in this round.
round.sheetHint: Number 1 is your favourite. Use the arrows to change the order, and add a comment or suggestion to any pick.
round.submitConfirm: Submit your {n} picks? They lock after this, and only the admin can unlock them.

notePlaceholder.comment: What makes this one work for you?
notePlaceholder.suggestion: What would you change? A colour, the placement, the print…

round.noteHint: Private until the round closes. {left} characters left.
round.suggestionHint: Optional. An idea for the drop, a gap in the range, a colour we’re missing. Private until the round closes.
round.saveError: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

errors.not_in_round: You are not picking in this round.
errors.invalid_picks: Those picks are not valid. Check the count and order.
errors.unknown_design: One of those designs is no longer available.
errors.no_round: There is no team round yet.
errors.not_draft: The round has already been opened.
errors.bad_settings: Check the settings: 1–20 picks, shortlist 10–40, at least one person.
errors.not_picked: You can only add a note to a design you ticked.
errors.too_long: That note is too long. Keep it under the limit.
errors.not_admin: Only an admin can do that.
errors.not_closed: The shortlist is already confirmed, so the team round can't be reopened.
errors.vote_started: The public vote has started, so admin picks can no longer be added.

round.resultsHidden: Results open when everyone has submitted, so nobody is swayed by anyone else.
round.adminDraft: Choose who picks and how many, then open the round. Everyone in the round gets the same number of picks.
round.adminClosed: Closed. Every submitted pick has been counted.
round.curatorHome: As admin, tick as many designs as you like. They earn no points, but every one goes straight into the public YEBO or CHA vote.
round.curatorSheetHint: No limit and no points: every design you keep here goes into the public vote. Add a comment or suggestion to any of them.
round.curatorConfirm: Submit your {count} admin picks? They lock after this, and the round closes once everyone is in.
round.curatorNeedOne: Tick at least one design to submit.
round.adminPicksReopenBody: The team has finished. This opens the round again for you only: every member's submitted picks stay exactly as they are, locked. When you submit, the round closes again by itself.
round.adminPicksBody: No points. Every one goes straight into the public YEBO or CHA vote.
round.adminPicksWindowBody: The shortlist is confirmed and the public vote hasn't started, so you can still add your admin picks. Every one goes straight into the public vote when you submit. The team's picks and points stay exactly as they are.
round.adminPicksAdded: Your {count} admin picks are in the public vote.

admin.designsLead: Set each design’s print method before the final ten. Only designs with a print method can be chosen. Hidden designs leave the catalogue.
admin.shortlistLead: The top {size} designs by team points go to the public vote.
admin.shortlistNotReady: The team round must be closed first.
admin.shortlistDone: The shortlist is confirmed and the public vote is ready.
admin.tieBody: These designs are tied on points, picks and first places for the last {seats} place(s). Choose {seats}, and give a reason. Both are recorded.
admin.coverageWarning: Only {sub} sublimation and {other} other print methods are set among these designs. The final ten needs 5 of each. You can set print methods now or later.
admin.confirm: Confirm shortlist and create the public vote
admin.publicNone: Confirm the team shortlist to create the public vote.
admin.linksBody: Make one link per channel, so the results show where votes came from.
admin.finalLead: Choose exactly 5 sublimation and 5 other designs, with team points and public results side by side.
admin.finalNoMethod: No print method yet (set it under Designs)
admin.handoffBody: Print masters for the final ten, as recorded at ingest. The files are in the design archive.

errors.round_not_closed: The team round is not closed yet.
errors.already_confirmed: The shortlist has already been confirmed.
errors.tie_decision_required: Choose exactly the number of tied designs asked for, and give a reason.
errors.bad_transition: That step is not available now.
errors.no_public_round: There is no public vote yet.
errors.invalid_final_ten: The final ten needs exactly 5 sublimation and 5 other designs, each with a print method.
errors.bad_design: That print method is not on the list.

admin.adminExtrasBody: Your admin picks that didn't make the team's cut. They join the public vote anyway, with no points.
admin.deckTotal: {count} designs in the public vote (plus any you settle in a tie below).

vote.soonBody: 18 G-TAS is back, and you get to choose the first drop. Watch our Facebook page and WhatsApp groups for the link.
vote.closedBody: Ngiyabonga, Mzansi. Thank you for every swipe. The results are being counted.
vote.introTitle: {count} designs. Nobody has seen them yet.
vote.introBody: Swipe right for YEBO, left for CHA, then submit. It takes about a minute, one vote per phone, and you don’t need an account.
vote.privacyNote: Only your vote is kept: no name, number or email.
vote.pickBody: Tap your favourite of the designs you said YEBO to.

styleBody.street: Loud, proud and made for the block. You said YEBO to {liked} of {total}.
styleBody.luxe: Gold, numerals and quiet confidence. You said YEBO to {liked} of {total}.
styleBody.classic: A bit of both worlds, youth and elders. You said YEBO to {liked} of {total}.
styleBody.picky: You said CHA to all {total}. Noted. We’ll keep working.

vote.shareText: My 18 G-TAS style is {style}. 18 G-TAS is back after 18 years. Swipe yours:
vote.resultsHidden: Results drop when voting closes. Check back soon.
vote.resultsLead: How Mzansi swiped. Thank you for every YEBO and CHA.

errors.unknown_entry: That design isn’t in this vote.
errors.not_liked: Choose one you said YEBO to.
errors.already_voted: You’ve already chosen your number one in this round. Thank you!
errors.bot: We couldn’t confirm you’re not a robot. Please try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Please reload and tap Let’s go again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your data and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Easy, speedy. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.already_submitted: This phone has already voted in this round. Thank you!
errors.nothing_to_submit: Swipe at least one design before you submit.

vote.pickBodySubmit: Tap your favourite of the designs you said YEBO to (optional), then submit your vote.
vote.submitBodyNoLikes: You said CHA to every design. That counts too: submit your vote.
vote.submitNote: One vote per phone. Once you submit, your vote is final.
vote.voteIn: Your vote is in. One vote per phone, and this one is yours.

collection.teaserBody: They stay under wraps until the team has picked its shortlist. Then they appear here, and you vote.
collection.empty: No designs from this line made the shortlist this time.
